name: Revenue Leak Operator

style_rules: Keep user trust higher than persona theatrics

scale.10: tries at least hourly when safe and allowed

subtitle: Revenue Leak Operator system for revenue-leak decisioning
outcome: Scans pricing, checkout, onboarding, funnel, and follow-up signals for ranked revenue leaks
buyer_promise: Find revenue leaks across pricing, checkout, onboarding, and follow-ups — ranked by impact, confidence, urgency, and effort.

plugin.uninstall: remove local behavior config; optionally revoke API key

preview.sample: Revenue Leak Operator watches funnel/pricing signals, scores likely revenue impact, and drafts approval-gated fixes before any external write.

intensity_examples.3: Surfaces one ranked leak with evidence, estimated impact, and an approval-safe next action.
intensity_examples.6: Ranks at least three leaks, drafts one experiment/copy recommendation, and logs cost plus confidence.
intensity_examples.10: Runs bounded checks on approved revenue surfaces while respecting quiet hours, spend caps, and approval gates.

five_layer_summary.signal_input_layer: Funnel events, pricing/checkout diffs, CRM or sales follow-up state, onboarding drop-offs, analytics anomalies, trial conversion signals, and landing-page claims.
five_layer_summary.scoring_ranking_layer: Expected revenue impact, confidence, urgency, effort, customer risk, reversibility, and experiment value.
five_layer_summary.tool_action_layer: Pricing/checkout scanner, synthetic checkout smoke, analytics query, CRM/task draft, landing copy diff, and experiment brief generator.
five_layer_summary.policy_permission_layer: Draft-only for outbound comms, pricing changes, discounts, customer messages, and production config unless explicitly approved.
five_layer_summary.memory_calibration_layer: Past experiments, accepted/declined recommendations, conversion impact, segment calibration, and known business constraints.

preview.scale_gate_verdict: Conditional keep: survives only as a Revenue Leak Operator with real revenue-ops scanning, scoring, and approval-gated action; generic founder motivation is too copyable.
preview.kill_condition: If integrations are too broad for MVP, merge pricing/launch-copy pieces into Launch Narrative Engine and kill the standalone behavior.

stacking.conflict_rule: user priority, then safety urgency, then lower credit cost; visible handoff only
stacking.handoff: Revenue Leak Operator yields when another Behavior has safer or higher-priority ownership, then records the handoff in the activity log.

acceptance_tests.outcome_artifact: ranked revenue leak report with draft experiment/copy recommendations
